captions.text: The atomic bombs
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Before we leave each other for the last time, do you have any questions to ask me?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You described to me the apparition of Ezekiel as being men equipped with diving suits, and you told me that the atmosphere of your planet was not the same as that of the Earth.
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: How is it that you are not wearing a diving suit at present?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: Because we too have made scientific progress, and now we can do without it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: My face appears to be in the open air; in reality it is protected by an invisible diving suit composed of repellent rays, inside which I breathe an air different from yours.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: These rays let the waves pass but not the molecules of the air.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You can compare that to the bubble emissions made inside your ports to prevent the fuel oil from getting out.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Do the atomic bombs constitute a danger for humanity?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: Yes, a great danger.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But that will allow us, in case of need, not to have much to do to destroy this civilization if men do not grow wiser.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Perhaps they will destroy themselves.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If they do not and they become threatening for us, it will suffice for us to make their stocks of bombs explode without sending offensive weapons against them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We could do that either by rays or by telepathy, by bringing it about that one of the great powers becomes the aggressor, which would automatically trigger a fatal riposte.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If men no longer want to be exposed to this peril, it suffices for them to take the atomic weapons away from the military.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Their power, applied gently, would make it possible to give the countries that lack energy the means to make great progress.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It would be urgent for you to stop the nuclear tests, for you do not know what you are exposing yourselves to.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: However, if men continue to play at atomizers, that will simplify things for us in case we should have to reduce them to silence.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: On your planet, do you have women?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: Yes, there is mention of it in the Bible, and I had you note the passage in question.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And children too?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: Yes, we can have children exactly like you.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Overpopulation
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: But you told me you were in a way immortal?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: How do you do to struggle against overpopulation?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: This problem, indeed, will arise very rapidly on the Earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: To resolve it, and you must resolve it right away, for you are numerous enough, you must develop contraception and make very strict laws authorizing women to have only two children.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If each couple engenders only two children, the population will manage to no longer increase.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: That too we are going to observe, how you get out of it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is yet another test of intelligence to see whether you deserve our inheritance.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I give you the solution to your present problem, to you who live only seventy-five years on average.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For us, indeed, the problem is different.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We are not eternal.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We can live, thanks to a small surgical intervention, the biblical tree of life, ten times longer than you.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We have children, and we apply the rule of which I have just spoken to you: 2 parents, 2 children, which means that our population is constant.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: How many are you?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: We are about 7 billion.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We met six days in a row; each time did you go back to your planet?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: No, I rejoined an intergalactic vessel that serves us as a base and that remains constantly near the Earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: How many are you on this vessel?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: Seven; on our planet there are seven provinces.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A representative of each of them is on this vessel.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If one adds two persons responsible for the vessel, we are permanently nine.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If the men of the Earth do exactly what you wish, what will happen?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: We will come officially to the residence that you will have prepared, and we will ask you to have the official representatives of the most important countries of humanity come there in order to obtain the total union of the peoples of the Earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If that goes well, we will make humanity benefit from our scientific advance, progressively.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: According to the use that will be made of it, we will see whether we can give men all our knowledge and thus make you enter the intergalactic era with our twenty-five thousand years of scientific advance for inheritance.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Are you the only world to possess this scientific level?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: In this region of the universe, yes.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There is an infinity of worlds inhabited by beings of humanoid type, whose scientific level is lower than ours, while being largely superior to yours.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: What makes us fear disappearing is that we have not found a planet having a civilization as evolved as ours.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We maintain economic relations with many other planets on which life was created by other men who must have had a scientific level equal to ours, as their religious writings prove to us.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Unfortunately, the creating civilizations closest to these worlds, it has been impossible for us to find them again.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Perhaps we will find some farther away, for we will continue to prospect the universe, ever farther.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In most cases their planet came too close to their sun and life became impossible, or their sun exploded or cooled too much.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: All that, although we notice nothing abnormal at present in our system, makes us fear the worst.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: So there is no religion among you?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: Our only religion is human genius.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We believe only in that, and we particularly love the memory of our own creators, whom we have never seen again and whose world we have not been able to find again.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They must have disappeared.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They had taken the precaution of putting into orbit around our planet an immense craft containing all their knowledge, which landed automatically on our planet when their world was destroyed.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Thanks to them we took up the torch.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This torch that we would like to see taken up by the Earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And if your planet were destroyed?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: The same process is foreseen which will automatically give you our inheritance, in case our world were annihilated.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The secret of eternity
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: You live ten times longer than we do?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: Our body lives ten times longer on average than yours, like the first men of the Bible.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Between seven hundred fifty and one thousand two hundred years.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But our mind, therefore our true personage, can be truly immortal.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I explained to you that from any cell whatever of a body one can recreate the entire being with new living matter: when we are in full possession of our means and our brain is at the maximum of its yield and of its knowledge, we have a minuscule part of our body surgically removed, which is conserved.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When we truly die, from a cell taken from the little piece of our body that was removed earlier, we completely recreate the body such as it was at that moment.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I do say such as it was at that moment, that is, with all its scientific knowledge and its personality of then.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But the body is constituted of new elements that have a thousand of your years to live before them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And so on eternally.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Only, in order to limit the increase of the population, only the geniuses have a right to this eternity.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: All the men of our planet have the removal of cells done at a certain age and hope that they will be chosen to be reborn after their death.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They hope for it, and all live trying to deserve this resurrection.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Once they are dead, a great council of the eternals meets to judge, in a last judgment, who are those who, having died during the year, deserve to live another life.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: During three existences, the eternal is a trainee, and at the end of these three lives, the council of the eternals meets to judge, in the light of the works of the interested party, whether he deserves to enter the council of the eternals as a perpetual member.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: From the moment one wishes a new life, one no longer has the right to have children.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Which does not prevent love, obviously.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This allows us to understand why the scientists, who were of the council of the eternals, wanted to create life on other planets.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They were transferring their procreative instinct onto other worlds.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: What are you called?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: If you want to give us a name, although we call ourselves men in our language, you can call us Elohim, since we have come from the sky.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: What language do you speak on your planet?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: Our official language closely resembles ancient Hebrew.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Each day we spoke here; were you not afraid that other men would surprise us?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: An automatic system would have warned me immediately of the approach of other men within a dangerous radius, by air or by land.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: What is your mode of life and of work among you?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: We practically work only intellectually, our scientific level allowing us to have robots for everything.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We work only when we feel like it and only with our brain.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Only the artists or the sportsmen work with their bodies, but because they have chosen it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The very evolved atomic energy is virtually inexhaustible, especially since we have found a means to use the atom in a closed circuit, and solar energy.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We have quantities of other sources of energy.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We do not necessarily use uranium for our atomic reactors, but many other simple and danger-free materials.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But if you live so long and do not work, do you not get bored?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: No, never, for we all do things that we love, and especially love.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We find our women very beautiful and we make the most of them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Does marriage exist?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: No, the women are free and the men too.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Couples exist; those who have chosen to live as a couple can do so, but they are free to take back their freedom when they want.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We all love one another.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Jealousy does not exist, since everyone can have everything and property does not exist.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There is no criminality among us, therefore no prison nor police.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There are, on the other hand, many doctors and regular medical examinations of the mind.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Those in whom the slightest moral imbalance is detected, which could lead to acts contrary to the freedom of each or to the life of others, are immediately subjected to a treatment that brings them back onto the right path.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Can you describe to me the day of an average man among you?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: In the morning he gets up, bathes, for there are swimming pools everywhere among us, has breakfast, then does what he feels like doing.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: All the people work, but because they feel like it, given that there is no money among us.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Thus, those who work do things that are always very well done, since they are done by vocation.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Only the eternals have very precise missions, such as for example the surveillance of the electronic brains and of the computers dealing with the vital problems, like energy, food, organization, etc. Out of 7 billion inhabitants there are only seven hundred eternals, who live completely on the margin of the other men.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They have the privilege of being eternal, but the duty of taking care of everything for the others, who are not obliged to work.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: To these seven hundred eternals must be added two hundred ten trainees (about seventy per year, that is, ten per province).
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Out of the seven billion inhabitants there are only about forty million children.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is only once they are of age (between eighteen and twenty-one years according to the subjects) that the children undergo the operation that gives them a longevity of more than seven hundred fifty years.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: At that moment, they can in their turn have children.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Which means that the oldest of our normal inhabitants know their descendants up to the fiftieth generation.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Out of seven billion inhabitants there are only about one million inactive, almost all in treatment, for they are generally the morally unbalanced who are cared for by our doctors for about six months.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The majority of men are interested in the arts, paint, sculpt, play music, write, make films, do sports, etc. We have a civilization of leisure in the full sense of the term.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The cities are on average of five hundred thousand inhabitants and cover only a very small space.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A city is in reality an immense house situated on a height, inside which people can sleep, love each other, do what pleases them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: These house cities are about a kilometer on each side and high and are crisscrossed in all directions by collective displacement waves.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You fasten a belt and you place yourself in the current of waves that carries you to wherever you desire, very rapidly.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The cities are kinds of cubes so as not to eat the countryside as is the case among you.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One of your cities of 500,000 inhabitants covers twenty times more surface than one of ours.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Result, when you want to go to the countryside you take several hours; we, we are there in a few tens of seconds.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: An entire city is conceived by the same architect in order to be more pleasant to look at and to integrate itself into the landscape.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But do the people who have nothing to do not get bored?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: No, for we give them heaps of activities.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The true values of the individual are recognized, and each wants to show that he has worth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Whether in art, in sciences, in sport, each wants to shine in order to become eternal or quite simply to be admired by the community or by a woman.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Some love risk, and to deprive them of the risk of dying would take away from them all pleasure of existing; thus the dangerous sports are particularly widespread.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We can bring back to life any wounded person whatever, but those who practice these sports can do so only if, in writing, they accept not to be cared for if they die during their sporting activity.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We have a kind of atomic automobile racing that would thrill you, and even more brutal games in the style of boxing, or more brutal still, a kind of rugby that is practiced naked and where all blows are permitted, boxing, wrestling, etc. All that may seem barbaric to you, but do not forget that every extreme must be balanced under penalty of downfall.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: An extremely sophisticated civilization must have primitive counterweights.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If our people did not have its idols, in its favorite sport, it would have only one desire, to die.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One must respect the life of others, but one must also respect their desire to die or to play with death within the framework of well-defined specialties.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There are among us competitions every year in all the branches, including a world competition that allows the best to be proposed for eternity.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Everyone lives only for that.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Each year, whether in painting, in literature, in biology, in medicine, in all the specialties where the human mind can express itself, a competition takes place in each province with a vote of the eternals of the province; the champions meet again in the capital to be submitted to the vote of a jury of eternals which designates the champions of champions, finally those who are presented to the great council of the eternals.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: These choose those who are worthy of becoming eternal trainees.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This is the goal, the ideal of each one.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The amusements can well take on primitive aspects when the supreme goal is so high.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: So the eternals have a life entirely different from the other inhabitants?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: Of course, they live apart, in cities that are reserved for them, and sit regularly to take decisions.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: How old are the oldest?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: The oldest, the president of the council of the Eternals, is twenty-five thousand years old, and you have him before you.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I have inhabited 25 bodies up to this day, and I am the first on whom this experiment was carried out; that is why I am the president of the eternals.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I myself directed the creation of life on the Earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You must have an immeasurable knowledge?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: Yes, I have accumulated quite a lot of knowledge, and I could not store much more of it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is in that that man will perhaps be superior to us, for the volume of the part of his brain that stores the information, the memory, is larger.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Men will therefore be able to store more knowledge and therefore go farther than us scientifically, if they have the means.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: That is indeed what frightens the opponents of the Council of the Eternals.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The man of the Earth can progress faster than us if nothing opposes it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Chemical education
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: But the knowledge that the students must accumulate must be enormous and take a lot of time?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: No, for thanks to an important scientific discovery that your scientists are beginning to glimpse, one can teach a subject his lessons surgically.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Your scientists have just discovered that one can, by injecting into the brain of a rat the liquid of the memory of an educated rat, bring it about that the rat that has learned nothing knows what the other knew.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One can communicate the information by injection of memorial cervical matter; thus our children have almost no work.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Regularly, they undergo injections of cervical matter taken from subjects possessing the information necessary for instruction.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The children thus have to concern themselves only with interesting things, programmed by themselves, to reconstruct the world in theory, to flourish in sport and the arts.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You never have war between the provinces of your world?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: Never; the sporting competitions are sufficiently developed to suppress the warlike instinct.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: On the other hand, psychologically, the fact for the young subjects of being able to risk their life in games where there are systematically, at each event, several deaths, suppresses the warlike instinct by allowing those who undergo it too intensely to satisfy it at the peril of their own life without dragging those who do not want it onto dangerous paths.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If on the Earth there were sports or games still more dangerous but organized, that would contribute to diminishing the possibilities of creation of international conflicts.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Are the seven peoples of your world alike?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: No, there are, as among you, different races and different cultures.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: These provinces were created as a function of these races, of these cultures, respecting the freedom and the independence of each.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Would it be possible for a man to visit your planet?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: Yes, it would suffice for you to put on a diving suit appropriate to your respiration so that you could come.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You could live without a diving suit in the residence where we have reproduced the terrestrial atmosphere and where several men of the Earth live, among them Moses, Elijah, Jesus Christ, and many other living testimonies of our creation, whom we will be able to make come back to the Earth in due time to support your words.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Why not have them come right away?
captions.speaker: Raël

captions.text: Because in your incredulous world, if Jesus Christ came back, he would be put in a lunatic asylum.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Imagine a man landing among you and saying he is the Christ.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He would bring only mockery and would very quickly be confined.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If we intervened by performing scientific prodigies to show that he is really the Christ, that would relaunch the religion based on God and revalue the supernatural or the mystical, which we do not want either.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Then the little man saluted me for the last time after having told me that he would return only when what he had asked of me was accomplished, and he climbed into his craft, which took off and disappeared like the other mornings.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Raëlian Movement
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: What a story!
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: What a revelation!
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Once at home, putting in order the notes I had taken, classifying them and recopying them, I realized the immense mission that was confided to me and the small chance I had of carrying it out well.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: But as it is not necessary to hope in order to undertake, I decided to do what was asked of me at the risk of being taken for a visionary.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: After all, if to be a visionary means to have received the light, then I am quite willing to be a visionary.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: It is better to be a visionary who knows than an enlightened man who does not know.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I wish to make clear to the skeptics of all kinds that I do not drink alcohol and that I sleep very well at night, thank you.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: One cannot dream six days in a row nor invent all that.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: To you who will not believe me, I say: look at the sky and you will see more and more apparitions that neither your scientists nor your military will be able to explain otherwise than by chatter destined to save face, which they would think they were losing if the truth did not come from one of those who are part of their closed circle.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: What, a scientist would not know!
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Like those who condemned Copernicus, because he had dared to say that the Earth was not the center of the world, could not admit that another than themselves reveal all that.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: But all of you who will see or have seen unidentified flying craft, which people will hasten to qualify as mirages or sounding balloons or hallucinations, all of you who do not dare to speak for fear that people will mock you, it is only by grouping together and addressing yourselves to those who believe in it that you will be able to speak freely.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: All these revelations have brought me an extreme well-being and a profound inner peace in this world where one no longer knows what to believe, where one can no longer believe in the white-bearded Good Lord and the devil with hooves, and where the official scientists do not manage to give a sufficiently precise explanation about our origins and our goals!
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: In the light of these revelations, everything becomes clear and everything appears simple.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: To know that there is somewhere in the universe a planet filled with people who created us similar to them, who love us while fearing that those they created may surpass them, is that not profoundly moving?
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Especially if one thinks that this humanity of which we are a part like them, it will be given to us soon to participate in its evolution by creating, in our turn, life on other worlds.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Now, you have read this book that I have written trying to reproduce as faithfully as possible everything that was said to me; perhaps you are going to think that I have an overflowing imagination and that these writings will have simply amused or distracted you — I would be profoundly disappointed by it; perhaps the revelation of these things will have given you back confidence in the future by allowing you to understand the mystery of creation and the destinies of man, thus answering the questions one asks oneself, at night, since childhood, wondering why one exists and what one is for on this earth — then I will be happy.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Finally, if you understand that all I have said is only the profound truth and wish, as I wish, to see very soon these men come officially, handing us their inheritance, if you want to participate in the realization of all that has been asked of me, I will have fulfilled my mission.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: In that case write to me, and we will welcome you within the Raëlian Movement; we will build the residence that they desire, and when we are numerous enough, throughout the world, to await them with the respect and the love that those who created us are entitled to demand, they will come and will make us benefit from their immense knowledge.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: All of you who believe in God or in Jesus Christ, you were right to believe in it, even if you thought it was not exactly what people wanted to make you believe, but that there was a foundation of truth.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: You were right to believe in the foundation of the writings but wrong to support the Church.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: If now you continue to distribute your money so that the cardinals have more beautiful robes, to authorize that the military exist by making the atomic threat hang over you, at your expense, that is because the golden age to which we now have a right does not interest you and you want to remain primitives.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: If, on the other hand, you want to participate, passively or actively, according to your means, in the development of the Raëlian Movement, take your pen and write to me.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: We are going very soon to be numerous enough to undertake the choice of the ground where the residence will rise.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: If you still doubt, read the newspapers and look at the sky; you will see that the apparitions of mysterious craft will be more and more numerous, to give you back the courage to send your letter.
captions.speaker: Narrator
